info.name: CampusCore API
info.description:
Complete CampusCore backend API collection (14 modules). Auto-generated from the Spring Boot controllers (CAMPUS-CORE build).

## Getting started
1. Select the **CampusCore (Local)** environment.
2. Run **Auth > Login** (or Register) — the JWT is captured automatically into the `accessToken` collection variable and sent as Bearer auth on every other request.
3. Adjust path IDs / query params as needed.

Base URL defaults to http://localhost:8300/api (server.port=8300, context-path=/api).
